item.title: 75-year-old woman attacked in Downtown Seattle, suspect arrested
item.description: A 42-year-old man was arrested after an attack on a 75-year-old woman in Downtown Seattle last week.

item.title: Boeing acquires 737 Max supplier Spirit AeroSystems in $4.7B deal
item.description: The deal, in the works for over a year, brings Boeing's largest provider of spare parts in-house. CEO Kelly Ortberg called it a “pivotal moment” for the company's future.

item.title: Atmospheric river to deliver 2 rounds of heavy rain, 6 WA rivers to flood stage
item.description: Steady heavy rain and gusty wind will impact the Seattle area on Monday, with rising rivers expected by midweek.

item.title: Washington State Ferries seeks new owners for aging fleet castoffs
item.description: Two retired Washington State Ferries are sitting idle on the shores of Bainbridge Island, decommissioned and deteriorating as state officials look for someone willing to take them on.

item.title: Here's where flooding is expected in western Washington this week
item.description: River flooding, coastal flooding and urban flooding is expected in some areas of western Washington this week, as an atmospheric river brings heavy rainfall across the region.

item.title: Everett, WA police chief retires, replacement to be appointed
item.description: The Everett Police Department's police chief, John DeRousse, is retiring. The department will swear in his replacement next month.

item.title: Sam Darnold, Seahawks offense shine in second half of victory over Falcons
item.description: Sam Darnold and Seattle’s offense didn’t get off to the start it wanted on Sunday, though the Seahawks quarterback certainly rounded into form in the second half.

item.title: Charter bus breaks down in Leavenworth, WA, leaving dozens stranded
item.description: A charter bus carrying more than 50 passengers from Puyallup to Leavenworth broke down, leaving the group stranded for hours overnight in the cold.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Rain break Tuesday morning, increasing showers by afternoon
item.description: A rain break is expected Tuesday morning, with mostly cloudy skies. Rivers will decrease in levels due to this dry period, then increase again as more rain is expected Tuesday night into Wednesday.

item.title: Crews prepare rescue boats ahead of possible flooding in western WA
item.description: Eastside Fire & Rescue is preparing for potential flooding this week by breaking out the rescue boats, with crews on standby to respond to water emergencies.
